about: Concentrated quality investing; the firm behind the Sequoia Fund.

checks.msg: 1 holding(s) left out of the copy record because the ticker's price didn't match the price filed (often an old ticker now used by another company): CRESY.

summary: Concentrated: 54 holdings, but the top ten are 67% of the portfolio.
Trades moderately: about 38% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 5.4 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced and much larger.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 4 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb was founded in 1969. Bill Ruane and Rick Cunniff launched the Sequoia Fund in 1970 to take Warren Buffett's former partnership investors when Buffett closed it. A four-person committee has run the fund since 2018.
profile.approach: Concentrated holdings in high-quality businesses bought at reasonable prices, held for a long time.
known: Returned 14.65% a year from 1970 to 2015, against 10.93% for the S&P 500.
Valeant grew to over 30% of the fund by 2015; its collapse cut Sequoia 22% and led to leadership changes.
